tier3_constraints.constraint_text: Grid stability decisions must be computed within 500ms.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This constraint directly relates to the time behaviour and resource utilisation of the system.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: Meter data ingestion must sustain 50,000 messages/second during peak collection windows.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This constraint directly relates to the throughput stability and resource utilisation of the system.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: The control system must maintain operation during partial network failures. Failover to backup control centers must complete within 30 seconds.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This constraint directly relates to the availability and fault tolerance of the system.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: Automated load shedding must include safety interlocks to prevent equipment damage and ensure critical facilities (hospitals, emergency services) are never disconnected.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This constraint directly relates to the hazard prevention and fault tolerance of the system.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: The platform itself must minimize computational energy consumption.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This constraint directly relates to the energy footprint reduction and environmental impact awareness of the system.
